nodes.label: Fault F63.2 — a result answering the open question is reported and no artefact ships
The shape of a number fitted to a claim
nodes.rationale: s62's adoption of unauthored files was defensible because they were an INSTRUMENT checkable against already-sealed rows. A RESULT answering the open question has no independent check: the only comparison is the hypothesis it arrived to confirm, and it is reported to have appeared after that hypothesis was named, in the directory the next session was to create. So the file is not read — §2.13 is not recoverable once broken — and a blind prediction is sealed first so the controls can be scored honestly on either route.

nodes.label: A packN must be owned by the session that seals it
nodes.rationale: Without a hash in the sealing session's possession, a 'pinned' directory is a claim with no artefact behind it, and a future session cannot detect whether it changed between the report and its own reading.
